title: Creative Mode PVP
description: Ever wanted to PVP in creative mode? This datapack adds new weapons to allow just that!
body:
Have you ever wanted to PVP your friends in Creative Mode? Well now you can! With 8 custom weapons and 2 custom healing items, take to the skies and combat your opponents.

See the video of it in action: https://youtu.be/7ueDcsRzC_c

Weapons work by reducing your opponent's abilities, reducing either their inventory space (red weapons), gravity (purple weapons), block interaction range (blue weapons), or entity interaction range (green weapons).

The resource pack and datapack are included in the download. Please read the "README.txt" file before you use it!

IMPORTANT:
To get the items yourself, run the command "/function cpvp:giveallitems" | There likely will be ways to obtain items individually in the future, but this should give you all relavant items.


<details>
<summary>Red Weapons</summary>

Red weapons reduce the amount of inventory space your opponent has on a hit.

**Melee**

The melee weapon travels instantly, and is affected by your entity interaction range. Upon use, you will either hear a miss sound, or a hit sound, which occurs when your weapon hits a player or block within range.

The melee weapon removes 3 inventory slots

**Long Range**

The long range weapon travels quickly with a range of around 120 blocks. Once it hits a target, it will dissapear, and remove 1 inventory slot from them.

Inventory slots can be regained naturally over time, or faster by standing on a beacon. The more powerful the beacon, the faster you heal (up to level 3 - level 4 beacons will NOT heal)

</details>
<details>
<summary>Purple Weapons</summary>

Purple weapons reduce the amount of gravity your opponent has on a hit.

**Melee**

Removes a substantial amount of gravity

**Long Range**

Removes a small amount of gravity

Gravity can be regained by drinking tungsten bottles. It can also be increased beyond normal limits by wearing netherite armor. The amount that netherite armor weighs you down is based on the number of materials needed to craft it (so a netherite chestplate will weigh you down 2x as much as netherite boots would)

</details>
<details>
<summary>Blue and Green Weapons</summary>

Blue and green weapons reduce the amount of block or entity interaction range your opponent has on a hit, respectively.

**Medium Range**

The long range weapon travels slowly with a range of around 90 blocks. Once it hits a target, it will remove a small amount of range from it's target, per hit. This does NOT dissapear on contact with a player - only with solid blocks.

**Long Range**

Removes a small amount of range

Range can be regained over time or by drinking a reach recovery potion.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Info Readouts</summary>
It's hard to know what your reach or gravity is at just a glance. You have to _test_ it first. So to fix that, you can apply a custom readout to help you know your stats more easily!

To change this, run the command "/trigger InfoReadout set [n]", where n is your "style". Each of the styles are listed below:

1 - Block Interaction Range: x%

2 - Block/Entity Interaction Range: x% | y%

3 - Block Interaction Range: x% | Gravity: z%

4 - Entity Interaction Range: y%

5 - Entity Interaction Range: y% | Gravity: z%

6 - Gravity: z%

7 - Block/Entity Interaction Range: x% | y% Gravity: 100%


</details>



<details>
<summary>For Content Creators</summary>
You may use this datapack in any monetized or unmonetized social media videos, as long as you give credit and provide a link to either the Modrinth or Planet Minecraft page of this datapack.
</details>
